outcome.reasoning: Poisson model: expected goals SSC Napoli 1.50 vs Torino FC 1.10, from each side's season scoring and conceding rates at this venue.

Torino FC away: 2W-1D-2L, 7 scored and 6 conceded in 5 games.
League averages this season: home teams 1.60 goals per game, away teams 1.51.
Recent league form (newest first): SSC Napoli DLWDL, Torino FC DLLWW (shown for context, not used by the model).
uncertainties: Statistical model only: it ignores injuries, suspensions, lineups, tactics, motivation, fixture congestion and weather.

Simple Poisson models tend to slightly underestimate draws.
